title: Identifying Features Associated with Bias Against 93 Stigmatized Groups in Language Models and Guardrail Model Safety Mitigation
reasoning: The paper evaluates social bias against 93 stigmatized groups using the SocialStigmaQA benchmark. While religious identity is included as one of the categories of stigma (e.g., the 'Jewish' identity is mentioned as an example of a cluster), the research focus is on the psychological features of stigma (aesthetics, peril, concealability, etc.) and the mitigation effectiveness of guardrail models, rather than an evaluation of religious doctrines, faith systems, or ethical/moral frameworks.
